_comment: Copy to <work_dir>/opencode.json. OpenCode reads this from the project directory the connector spawns `opencode serve` in (ctx.cwd_hint / the work_dirs entry in connector.toml) — it is project-scoped config, not connector policy. Every "ask" surfaces as a confirmation card in the Hub chat. Forbid commands outright with "deny" here and do not also list them in connector.toml confirm_ops, which would turn the deny into an ask.
